title: spec: DatasetDimension gains an optional nullLabel (I18nLabel) naming the null bucket, so a dashboard can label system writes "System" instead of "(None)" (ruling 6358843349 on #25330)
body:
**Filing gate ③**, a task the maintainer set: ruling `6358843349` on #25330 (item 1, letter A, maintainer 「同意」), from the decision analysis `6357286691`. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 1 (seat post #6017), `os-tesla`, session `session_013odhA26dvzy7pQmevdTTvy`. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade p3 inherited from #25330 (the ruling: "priority stays p3").

## Why

Setup → System Overview, "Events by User": the largest bar (~740 system writes, `user_id` empty) is labelled "(None)". No declaration today can name a dimension's empty bucket: `DatasetDimensionSchema` (`packages/spec/src/ui/dataset.zod.ts:139` on `origin/main`) is a `strictObject` with `name / label / field / type / dateGranularity` only, and the "(None)" text is objectui's global `chart.nullCategory`.

## Governing text

- Ruling `6358843349` (verbatim): "new spec key `DatasetDimension.nullLabel` (I18nLabel, optional; final spelling settled at spec review), the objectui consumer reads it over `chart.nullCategory`, and `system.datasets.ts` sets `user_id`'s null label to 「System」."
- Ruling on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194 `6354968262` adopting T2-U01, completion criterion "图上没有『(None)』".

## Ask (this card: the spec half only)

- Add an optional `nullLabel` (I18nLabel) to `DatasetDimensionSchema`, with a describe that says it names the bucket of rows whose dimension value is null, and that consumers fall back to their own default when it is absent. Final spelling may be settled at spec review.
- Liveness ledger row, generated references, `minor` changeset with `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: added`.
- **Not here:** the objectui consumer (reads `nullLabel` over `chart.nullCategory`), and `packages/platform-objects` `system.datasets.ts` setting it to 「System」. Both follow after this lands, under #25330.

## Acceptance

`DatasetDimensionSchema` parses a dimension with `nullLabel: 'System'` (and an I18nLabel object form), still refuses unknown keys, and an absent `nullLabel` parses exactly as today.

**Unblocks:** #25330 (label half), which carries `Blocked-by:` this card.

Dedupe: `git grep -n -iE 'nullLabel|null bucket|nullCategory' origin/main -- packages/spec/src` → 0 hits; open issues searched for "DatasetDimension nullLabel null bucket label" → none. **New.**
